cli.help:
MusicFS — Your online music as local files

Usage: musicfs [options]

  --headless                  Run without a desktop; print access instructions
  --foreground                Stay in this terminal; Ctrl+C stops the service
  --no-open                   Do not open a browser
  --data <directory>          Use this data directory on every launch
  --management-access <scope> Management access: local or lan
  --management-port <port>    Management port; 0 selects automatically
  --dav-access <scope>        WebDAV access: local or lan
  --dav-port <port>           WebDAV port; 0 selects automatically
  --language <zh-CN|en>       Language for terminal and tray
  --no-integration            Disable tray and desktop startup registration
  -h, --help                  Show help

The service runs in the background and survives closing the terminal.
Run MusicFS again to reuse the service and get a fresh login link.
Headless mode is automatic over SSH or without a Linux graphical session.
Management and WebDAV default to local access with separate saved ports.

Examples:
  musicfs --headless
  musicfs --headless --management-access lan --management-port 8787
  musicfs --headless --dav-access lan --dav-port 8788
  musicfs --foreground --data /home/me/.local/share/MusicFS
